metric: Native persona-goal success, physical nonfixture evidence, valid and faithful execution, no timeout and no controller error. Scored policy errors fail.
aggregation: Mean observed trials within each observed persona, then mean observed personas within each task, then mean of all 100 tasks. This differs from pooled episode success.
missingData: Infrastructure errors remain unscored. Three entirely unobserved Opus API personas are excluded from the conditional task means; all 100 tasks have some observed data.

source.sourceMethod: All displayed point estimates follow the latest paper figure. Five archived strict report files were SHA-256-verified, and their success counts and task-balanced means were independently recomputed as archived evidence. This archive check does not independently recompute the current paper's revised Astra high point.

notes: The current paper author-reported Astra high point is33.2%. Its archived strict trial records below yield30.1667% task-balanced success; this archival row does not validate or recompute the revised point.
Per-persona counts permit independent reproduction of the archived means. Pooled successes / scored is a different weighting and does not define the displayed task-balanced metric.
